name: Gods
overview: Scripture reveals the true nature of God as a loving and mighty Savior who thoughtfully plans for our well-being and ultimate hope, as seen in Jeremiah 29:11 and Zephaniah 3:17. The gospel affirms God's sacrificial love through Christ, who died for sinners to grant eternal life, emphasizing the importance of trusting and doing God's will rather than following false gods. These verses encourage believers to enter God's rest by embracing His word and purposes with faith and obedience.
